svg.text: CHAPTERS 6A TO 6C · THE BUYERS, THE BIDDERS, THE VENDORS
The buyers' door is flooded. The bidders are the thicket. The vendors sell shovels to both, and would like to own the sun.
shovels: the platforms, the specialists, the startups, the general model
the bid platform, up the ladder:
it owns the memory and wants the sun
1 the highway agency: a bid file the owner writes
2 the public building owner: PDFs, every one read
4 the private owner: may shut the door
5 the Construction Manager: answers to the owner
They need volume without hiring, awards that
survive a protest, and the door kept open. The
law leaves a public buyer the fourth answer: a
published check, with no cap, key or fee.
They want a check before the bid goes in, a fair and
predictable hearing, and their own data kept their
own. In the thicket a polished bid is only polish; a
bid that read the same documents and priced the same
quantities is the bidder showing it is alive.
They need a target to build to
and the sun was never for
Chapters 6a to 6c take the parties one at a time: who they are, what they need, and what a published check does for them.
